question: What oath did Saul make the people swear during the battle?
options: That they would not take any plunder
That they would not rest until night
That anyone who ate food before evening would be cursed
That they would kill every Philistine
explanation: Saul bound the people under an oath, saying, "Cursed be anyone who eats food before evening comes, before I have avenged myself on my enemies!"
